name: Katie Clark
bio: Empowered teams. Great delivery. With 8+ years of experience leading and coaching complex projects across industries, such as semiconductors and food supply, I focus on creating environments where talents can truly perform and grow. I help teams deliver by fostering collaboration, building trust, and shaping effective ways of working. Using agile practices, I encourage continuous reflection, ownership, and a willingness to experiment.My approach is simple: small, meaningful changes at the right pace. Over time, these create momentum, unlock potential, and lead to lasting impact. I'm particularly strong at balancing the bigger picture - strategy, budgets, staffing, and roadmaps - with the realities of day-to-day execution.
